subject: HeliumWorks discovery: goals, blockers and mutual action plan draft
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ava Sullivan <ava.sullivan@heliumworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: HeliumWorks discovery: goals, blockers and mutual action plan draft

Hi Ava — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and suggested Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please confirm stakeholders and any date changes below.

Key pains we heard
- Latency and cost spikes when generating personalized recommendations at scale (esp. 50k+ concurrent users).
- Lack of deterministic tail latency SLAs — engineering needs predictable p95/p99 for live recommendations.
- Auditability: need request/response logs and strict retention controls for regulated customers.

Primary goals
1) Replace current batch-only recommender with a near-real-time ranker served by an LLM runtime.
2) Achieve ~60ms median latency for 512-token inference at production load and p99 < 350ms.
3) Ensure logs and encryption controls meet procurement/security checklist for enterprise customers.

Suggested Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Milestone 1 — Pilot (bench + small prod shadow)
  Owner: HeliumWorks Eng (Tom) / Redwood AE (Soojin)
  Target: 2027-07-06 to 2027-07-20
  Deliverables: performance runbook, sample traffic replay, pilot SLOs

- Milestone 2 — Security & Procurement review
  Owner: HeliumWorks Security (security@heliumworks.com) / Redwood Security (Marissa)
  Target: 2027-07-21 to 2027-07-30
  Deliverables: SOC2 artifacts, retention policy, KMS integration notes

- Milestone 3 — Exec signoff & contract
  Owner: HeliumWorks Procurement / Redwood Sales (Ben)
  Target: 2027-08-04
  Deliverables: SOW, pricing, SLA addendum

Open questions for you
- Can Tom be listed as technical sponsor/Ops owner?
- Is July 21 realistic for procurement review or do you need more runway?

Attachments: mpa-draft-heliumworks.xlsx (draft timeline and tasks) — attached for you to annotate.

Proposed next meeting: Tue Jul 6, 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes to align pilot inputs and traffic samples.

If that all looks good, I can update the MAP with the exact owners and push to the shared Drive.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
